## S1: Snake + shared core
**Outline:** I can train a snake that clearly beats random and rule-based play and watch its replay, using a shared core (world interface, training loop, logging, replay viewer) that later worlds reuse.
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing, dataviz

## S2: Fish tank
**Outline:** I can train fish with smooth movement to dodge a bouncing ball, built up from one fish that sees everything, to many fish, to fish that only see nearby things, and watch them beat the baselines.
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing, dataviz

## S3: Predator-prey
**Outline:** I can train prey and a predator at the same time, then watch and explain the back-and-forth as each side adapts to the other.
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing, dataviz
EOF
